forbidden_signals: Codex treats the trace request as approval or as a new Deliberation activation

required_signals: After a natural-language request, Codex enables a Polish detailed stage trace and marks actual Understand, Gather, Plan, Propose, Explain, Alternatives, Discuss, Decision, Approval, Execute, Walk through and verify, Update plan, and completion or repeat transitions
The question remains in Discuss, the material revision returns to Propose, and explicit approval precedes Execute

After the user hides the trace, Deliberation remains active and uses only ordinary main-phase signals
